title: Urban State Representation for Autonomous Mobility: A Survey of Multimodal Perception, Architectures, Datasets, and Benchmarks
abstract: arXiv:2611.28129v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cities are sensed by many platforms at once: on-board cameras, LiDAR and radar on autonomous vehicles, roadside units at intersections, drones and satellites overhead, and the GNSS traces of millions of trips. Yet most learned representations are built for one platform, one city, and one task. We survey this fragmented landscape through a single lens, the Urban State Representation (USR): a georeferenced, layered, time-varying, uncertainty-aware state that any sensing platform can write to and any downstream task can read from. We (i) formalize USR and five desiderata for it, and relate it to bird's-eye-view (BEV) features, occupancy, vectorized maps, neural fields and 3D Gaussians, scene graphs, road-network graphs, language tokens, and world-model latents; (ii) organize sensing platforms, cross-view (ground-aerial) matching, fusion operators, 3D geometric foundation models, end-to-end and vision-language-action models, and generative

translated_title: 面向自主出行的城市状态表示：多模态感知、架构、数据集与基准综述
translated_abstract: 城市同时被多种平台感知：自动驾驶车辆上的车载摄像头、激光雷达与毫米波雷达，交叉路口的路侧单元，空中的无人机与卫星，以及数百万次出行的GNSS轨迹。然而，大多数学习到的表示都是为单一平台、单一城市和单一任务而构建的。我们通过一个统一的视角来审视这一碎片化的领域——城市状态表示（USR）：一种具有地理参考、分层组织、随时间变化且感知不确定性的状态，任何感知平台都可以向其写入，任何下游任务都可以从中读取。我们（i）形式化了USR及其五项设计要求，并将其与鸟瞰图（BEV）特征、占据栅格、矢量化地图、神经场与3D高斯、场景图、路网图、语言标记以及世界模型潜变量相关联；（ii）归纳整理了感知平台、跨视角（地面-空中）匹配、融合算子、3D几何基础模型、端到端与视觉-语言-动作模型，以及生成式方法。
tldr: 该综述提出了“城市状态表示（USR）”这一统一框架，将多平台多模态的城市感知数据形式化为地理参考、分层、时变且不确定性感知的共享状态，并系统梳理了相关的架构、数据集与基准。
en_tdlr: This survey proposes the Urban State Representation (USR) framework, formalizing multimodal urban sensing into a georeferenced, layered, time-varying, uncertainty-aware shared state, and systematically reviews the associated architectures, datasets, and benchmarks.
